under tight deadlines. Natural problem solver. Clear and direct. Performance
focused. Mentors others. Client-facing delivery.

## Skills

### Web frameworks
Builds websites and web applications.
React, Angular, Vue, Astro, Symfony, Redux

### AI and automation
Builds AI assistants and automates repetitive work.
AI agents, agentic coding, automation, OpenCode, LM Studio, Google ADK, OpenAI
API, Hugging Face, local models, GPT OSS, DeepSeek, Nemotron, GLM, Gemma,
prompt engineering

### Content management systems
Enables teams to publish and manage their own content.
Contentful, Decap CMS, WordPress, TeamSite, AEM

### Front-end
Everything the visitor sees and interacts with in a browser.
HTML, CSS, SCSS, responsive design, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, daisyUI, Bootstrap,
Foundation, Skeleton, JavaScript, TypeScript, Canvas, game logic, GSAP, service
workers, Vite, bespoke functionality

### Back-end
Servers, APIs, authentication and application logic.
Node.js, Express, Fastify, PHP, ASP, API design, Stripe, Facebook API, user
authentication, SSO, pipeline design, Socket.IO, WebSockets

### Databases
Stores and queries application data.
SQL, NoSQL, JSON, XML, data conversion, MongoDB, DynamoDB, SQLite, MySQL,
database design, migrations, ORM

### Cloud and infrastructure
Deployments, hosting, application scaling.
AWS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, load balancers,
autoscaling, edge functions, DNS, HTTPS, certificates, Lightsail, Netlify,
Vercel, Unix, Linux

### Build and development
Builds, packages and manages web applications.
Git, Composer, npm, npm workspaces, Webpack, Parcel, Gulp, CI/CD pipelines,
continuous deployment, artifact delivery

### Accessibility, security and compliance
Builds accessible, secure and privacy-conscious applications.
WCAG, AODA, OWASP, web application security, GDPR, web privacy, i18n
